name: uniprot-parquet
title: UniProtKB Parquet Data Lake
description: An analysis-ready Parquet representation of the complete UniProtKB database. Five sorted tables (entries, features, xrefs, comments, publications) hold UniProt's JSON as it is shipped, one column per key (source columns), next to typed shortcut columns for common query patterns; accession_map resolves primary and secondary accessions. Per-file SHA-256 hashes are in SHA256SUMS.txt and manifest.json file_details. The data is CC BY 4.0; its client (homepage) is MIT.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: UniProt data is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0

resources.name: entries
resources.description: One row per protein. Primary table for most queries.

fields.name: accession
fields.description: UniProtKB primary accession (e.g. P05067). Stable identifier; unique per entry.

fields.name: id
fields.description: UniProtKB mnemonic entry name (e.g. A4_HUMAN). May change between releases.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True for Swiss-Prot (manually reviewed); false for TrEMBL (automated annotation).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the source organism (e.g. 9606 for Homo sapiens).

fields.name: organism_scientific_name
fields.description: Scientific name of the source organism.

fields.name: gene_primary
fields.description: Primary gene name of each gene of the entry, in the genes array's order; NULL for a gene with no geneName (ORF or ordered locus names only).

fields.name: protein_name_primary
fields.description: Recommended (Swiss-Prot) or submitted (TrEMBL) full protein name.

fields.name: length
fields.description: Sequence length in amino acids.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: The sequence: value (amino acids, one-letter codes), length, molWeight, crc64, md5. Read sequence.value for the amino acids. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<value: string, length: int64, molWeight: int64, crc64: string, md5: string>

fields.name: gene_synonym
fields.description: Flattened list of gene name synonyms across all genes.

fields.name: alt_protein_names
fields.description: List of alternative full protein names from proteinDescription.alternativeNames.

fields.name: ec
fields.description: Distinct EC (Enzyme Commission) numbers from every naming block (recommended, alternative, submission names) of the entry and of its domains (includes) and chains (contains), in order of first appearance.

fields.name: division
fields.description: UniProt taxonomic division (archaea, bacteria, fungi, human, invertebrates, mammals, plants, rodents, vertebrates, viruses, unclassified), derived from lineage and organism_id.

fields.name: go_id
fields.description: Distinct Gene Ontology term IDs (e.g. GO:0005634) from cross-references, in order of first appearance.

fields.name: go_terms
fields.description: GO annotations as {id, aspect (P/F/C), term, evidence_type}; go_id is the flat id list.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<id: string, aspect: string, term: string, evidence_type: string>>

fields.name: xref_dbs
fields.description: Distinct database names referenced in cross-references (e.g. PDB, Ensembl), in order of first appearance.

fields.name: proteome_id
fields.description: Distinct UniProt proteome ids (UP…) from cross-references, sorted.

fields.name: keywordid
fields.description: UniProt keyword IDs (e.g. KW-0418).

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: UniProt keyword names (e.g. 'Kinase').

fields.name: keyword_categories
fields.description: Keyword categories aligned with keywordid (e.g. Molecular function, Biological process).

fields.name: date_created
fields.description: Date the entry was first made public in UniProtKB (entryAudit.firstPublicDate as a DATE).

fields.name: date_modified
fields.description: Date of the last annotation update (entryAudit.lastAnnotationUpdateDate as a DATE).

fields.name: date_sequence_modified
fields.description: Date of the last sequence update (entryAudit.lastSequenceUpdateDate as a DATE).

fields.name: feature_count
fields.description: Number of positional features (rows in features).

fields.name: xref_count
fields.description: Number of cross-references to external databases (rows in xrefs).

fields.name: comment_count
fields.description: Number of comment annotations (rows in comments).

fields.name: reference_count
fields.description: Number of literature/submission references (rows in publications).

fields.name: lit_pubmed_id
fields.description: Distinct PubMed ids cited by the entry, as strings: numeric ids in numeric order, then any non-numeric id.

fields.name: entryType
fields.description: Entry type, e.g. 'UniProtKB reviewed (Swiss-Prot)'. Type follows the input.

fields.name: primaryAccession
fields.description: Primary accession, as shipped (the accession shortcut holds the same value). Type follows the input.

fields.name: secondaryAccessions
fields.description: Secondary (merged/demerged) accessions that resolve to this entry. Type follows the input.

fields.name: uniProtkbId
fields.description: Mnemonic entry name (the same value as id). Type follows the input.

fields.name: entryAudit
fields.description: Dates and versions: firstPublicDate, lastAnnotationUpdateDate, lastSequenceUpdateDate, entryVersion, sequenceVersion. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<firstPublicDate: string, lastAnnotationUpdateDate: string, lastSequenceUpdateDate: string, entryVersion: int64, sequenceVersion: int64>

fields.name: annotationScore
fields.description: UniProt annotation score (1-5). Type follows the input.

fields.name: organism
fields.description: Source organism: scientificName, commonName, synonyms, taxonId, lineage, evidences. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<scientificName: string, commonName: string, taxonId: int64, lineage: list<l: string>, synonyms: list<l: string>, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>

fields.name: proteinExistence
fields.description: Protein existence evidence level (e.g. '1: Evidence at protein level'). Type follows the input.

fields.name: genes
fields.description: Genes: geneName, synonyms, orfNames, orderedLocusNames (with evidences). Type follows the input.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Keywords: id, category, name, evidences. Type follows the input.

fields.description: countByCommentType, countByFeatureType, uniParcId, ... Type follows the input.

fields.name: organismHosts
fields.description: Host organisms (of viruses). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<scientificName: string, commonName: string, taxonId: int64>>

resources.name: features
resources.description: One row per positional annotation (domain, signal, transmembrane, etc). Sorted by (reviewed DESC, organism_id ASC, accession ASC, feature_index ASC): within a protein, features appear in UniProt's order; use ORDER BY start_pos for position order.

fields.name: accession
fields.description: Parent entry's primary accession. Foreign key → entries.accession.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True if the parent entry is Swiss-Prot (reviewed).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the parent entry. Foreign key → entries.organism_id.

fields.name: organism_scientific_name
fields.description: Scientific name of the parent entry's organism (denormalized for convenience).

fields.name: length
fields.description: Sequence length of the parent entry (denormalized for coverage calculations).

fields.name: feature_index
fields.description: Position of this feature in the entry's features array (0-based). ORDER BY feature_index gives UniProt's order.

fields.name: start_pos
fields.description: Start position in the sequence (1-based, inclusive): location.start.value.

fields.name: end_pos
fields.description: End position in the sequence (1-based, inclusive): location.end.value.

fields.name: ligand_id
fields.description: ChEBI or other identifier of the bound ligand (ligand.id). May be null.

fields.name: evidence_codes
fields.description: Evidence codes (e.g. ECO:0000269) of evidences, in order.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Feature type (e.g. 'Domain', 'Signal peptide', 'Natural variant'). Type follows the input.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location: start and end ({value, modifier}), and sequence (an isoform) when not the canonical one. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<start: struct<value: int64, modifier: string>, end: struct<value: int64, modifier: string>>

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text description of the feature. Type follows the input.

fields.name: evidences
fields.description: Evidence records (evidenceCode, source, id). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>

fields.name: featureId
fields.description: UniProt feature identifier (e.g. PRO_0000001234). Type follows the input.

fields.name: featureCrossReferences
fields.description: Cross-references of the feature (e.g. dbSNP). Type follows the input.

fields.name: alternativeSequence
fields.description: Variant sequences: originalSequence and alternativeSequences. Type follows the input.

fields.name: ligand
fields.description: Bound ligand of a binding site: name, id, label, note. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<name: string, id: string, label: string, note: string>

fields.name: ligandPart
fields.description: Part of the ligand that binds: name, id, label, note. Type follows the input.

resources.name: xrefs
resources.description: One row per cross-reference to an external database (PDB, Ensembl, GO, InterPro, etc).

fields.name: accession
fields.description: Parent entry's primary accession. Foreign key → entries.accession.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True if the parent entry is Swiss-Prot (reviewed).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the parent entry. Foreign key → entries.organism_id.

fields.name: xref_index
fields.description: Position of this cross-reference in the entry's uniProtKBCrossReferences array (0-based).

fields.name: database
fields.description: External database name (e.g. 'PDB', 'Ensembl', 'GO', 'InterPro'). Type follows the input.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Identifier in the external database (e.g. '1ABC' for PDB). Type follows the input.

fields.name: properties
fields.description: Database-specific properties, a list of {key, value}. Type follows the input.

fields.name: evidences
fields.description: Evidence records supporting this cross-reference. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>

fields.name: isoformId
fields.description: Isoform accession when the cross-reference is specific to an isoform. Type follows the input.

resources.name: comments
resources.description: One row per comment annotation (function, subcellular location, disease, etc).

fields.name: accession
fields.description: Parent entry's primary accession. Foreign key → entries.accession.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True if the parent entry is Swiss-Prot (reviewed).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the parent entry. Foreign key → entries.organism_id.

fields.name: comment_index
fields.description: Position of this comment in the entry's comments array (0-based).

fields.name: text_value
fields.description: The texts' values joined by a blank line. Null for comments without texts (structured types, and DISEASE / SUBCELLULAR LOCATION, whose prose is in note).

fields.name: texts
fields.description: Free-text paragraphs ({value, evidences}). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string>>

fields.name: commentType
fields.description: Comment type (e.g. 'FUNCTION', 'DISEASE', 'SUBCELLULAR LOCATION'). Type follows the input.

fields.name: interactions
fields.description: Binary interactions (INTERACTION). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<interactantOne: struct<uniProtKBAccession: string, intActId: string, chainId: string>, interactantTwo: struct<uniProtKBAccession: string, geneName: string, intActId: string, chainId: string>, numberOfExperiments: int64, organismDiffer: bool>>

fields.name: disease
fields.description: Disease: diseaseId, acronym, description, diseaseCrossReference (DISEASE). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<diseaseId: string, diseaseAccession: string, acronym: string, description: string, diseaseCrossReference: struct<database: string, id: string>, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>

fields.name: note
fields.description: Note of the comment (texts). Type follows the input.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Alternative-products events, e.g. 'Alternative splicing' (ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS). Type follows the input.

fields.name: isoforms
fields.description: Isoforms: name, isoformIds, isoformSequenceStatus, sequenceIds (ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<name: struct<value: string>, isoformIds: list<l: string>, isoformSequenceStatus: string, sequenceIds: list<l: string>, synonyms: list<l: struct<value: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>>>>

fields.name: resourceName
fields.description: Name of an online resource (WEB RESOURCE). Type follows the input.

fields.name: resourceUrl
fields.description: URL of an online resource (WEB RESOURCE). Type follows the input.

fields.name: ftp
fields.description: Whether the web resource is an FTP site (WEB RESOURCE). Type follows the input.

fields.name: subcellularLocations
fields.description: Subcellular locations, topologies and orientations (SUBCELLULAR LOCATION). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<location: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string, id: string>, topology: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string, id: string>, orientation: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string, id: string>>>

fields.name: sequenceCautionType
fields.description: Kind of sequence conflict (SEQUENCE CAUTION). Type follows the input.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Sequence the caution refers to (SEQUENCE CAUTION). Type follows the input.

fields.name: evidences
fields.description: Evidence records of the comment. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>

fields.name: molecule
fields.description: Isoform or chain the comment applies to. Type follows the input.

fields.name: reaction
fields.description: Catalysed reaction (CATALYTIC ACTIVITY): name, reactionCrossReferences, ecNumber. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<name: string, reactionCrossReferences: list<l: struct<database: string, id: string>>, ecNumber: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>

fields.name: cofactors
fields.description: Cofactors (COFACTOR). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<name: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, cofactorCrossReference: struct<database: string, id: string>>>

fields.name: kineticParameters
fields.description: Kinetic parameters (BIOPHYSICOCHEMICAL PROPERTIES). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<maximumVelocities: list<l: struct<velocity: double, unit: string, enzyme: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>>, michaelisConstants: list<l: struct<constant: double, unit: string, substrate: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>>>

fields.name: phDependence
fields.description: pH dependence (BIOPHYSICOCHEMICAL PROPERTIES). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<texts: list<l: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string>>>

fields.name: method
fields.description: Measurement method (MASS SPECTROMETRY). Type follows the input.

fields.name: molWeight
fields.description: Measured molecular weight (MASS SPECTROMETRY). Type follows the input.

fields.name: molWeightError
fields.description: Error of the measured weight (MASS SPECTROMETRY). Type follows the input.

fields.name: physiologicalReactions
fields.description: Physiological direction of the reaction (CATALYTIC ACTIVITY). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<directionType: string, reactionCrossReference: struct<database: string, id: string>, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>>

fields.name: temperatureDependence
fields.description: Temperature dependence (BIOPHYSICOCHEMICAL PROPERTIES). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<texts: list<l: struct<evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>, value: string>>>

resources.name: publications
resources.description: One row per literature citation or submission (derived from UniProtKB entry.references).

fields.name: accession
fields.description: Parent entry's primary accession. Foreign key → entries.accession.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True if the parent entry is Swiss-Prot (reviewed).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the parent entry. Foreign key → entries.organism_id.

fields.name: reference_index
fields.description: Position of this reference in the entry's references array (0-based).

fields.name: referenceNumber
fields.description: Number of the reference in the entry's reference list. Type follows the input.

fields.name: citation
fields.description: The citation: citationType, id, title, authors, authoringGroup, publicationDate, journal, volume, firstPage, lastPage, submissionDatabase, citationCrossReferences, ... Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: struct<id: string, citationType: string, authors: list<l: string>, citationCrossReferences: list<l: struct<database: string, id: string>>, title: string, publicationDate: string, journal: string, firstPage: string, lastPage: string, volume: string, submissionDatabase: string, authoringGroup: list<l: string>, institute: string, address: string>

fields.name: referencePositions
fields.description: What the reference is cited for (e.g. 'NUCLEOTIDE SEQUENCE'). Type follows the input.

fields.name: referenceComments
fields.description: Reference comments (strain, tissue, plasmid, ...). Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<value: string, type: string, evidences: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>>>

fields.name: evidences
fields.description: Evidence records of this reference. Type follows the input.
fields.arrowType: list<l: struct<evidenceCode: string, source: string, id: string>>

resources.name: accession_map
resources.description: One row per primary or secondary accession, mapping to the current primary accession. The lookup table for point queries and for resolving retired accessions.

fields.name: accession
fields.description: Primary or secondary accession (the lookup key). A secondary accession can map to more than one primary (split entries).

fields.name: primary_accession
fields.description: Current primary accession the key resolves to (FK → entries.accession).

fields.name: is_primary
fields.description: True when accession == primary_accession.

fields.name: reviewed
fields.description: True if the primary entry is Swiss-Prot (copied from entries.reviewed).

fields.name: organism_id
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the primary entry (copied from entries.organism_id).

partitioning.note: accession_map is excluded from any future second partition level
